say:1:1510355001:0.text: It's a miracle! Their conditions have all improved!
say:1:1510355001:0.source_cn: 神、神迹！他们的状况都好转了！

say:2:1510355002:1.text: So, this is divine power! Incredible!
say:2:1510355002:1.source_cn: 不可置信……这就是神明的力量！

say:5:1510355003:1.text: Herdmaster... From what I've been told, you're a bloodthirsty, cruel deity. And your followers, the Wildborn, are as savage as you.
say:5:1510355003:1.source_cn: ……狩猎神，我之前所知，你是一位嗜血残暴的神明，为了满...
say:5:1510355003:1.male: Herdmaster... From what I've been told, you're a bloodthirsty, cruel deity. And your followers, the Wildborn, are as savage as you.
say:5:1510355003:1.female: Herdmaster... From what I've been told, you're a bloodthirsty, cruel deity. And your followers, the Wildborn, are as savage as you.

say:6:1510355004:1.text: But you're not as cruel as the rumors say.
say:6:1510355004:1.source_cn: 但今天所见，你并不像传闻中那般残酷。
say:6:1510355004:1.male: But you're not as cruel as the rumors say.
say:6:1510355004:1.female: But you're not as cruel as the rumors say.

say:8:1510355006:1.text: Regardless, for saving my soldiers, I would like to express my respect and gratitude...
say:8:1510355006:1.source_cn: 无论如何，仅就你拯救了我的士兵而言，呼临向你表达敬意…...
say:8:1510355006:1.male: Regardless, for saving my soldiers, I would like to express my respect and gratitude...
say:8:1510355006:1.female: Regardless, for saving my soldiers, I would like to express my respect and gratitude...

choice_prompt:9:1510355006.text: Regardless, for saving my soldiers, I would like to express my respect and gratitude...
choice_prompt:9:1510355006.source_cn: 无论如何，仅就你拯救了我的士兵而言，呼临向你表达敬意……与感激。
choice_prompt:9:1510355006.male: Regardless, for saving my soldiers, I would like to express my respect and gratitude...
choice_prompt:9:1510355006.female: Regardless, for saving my soldiers, I would like to express my respect and gratitude...

say:10:1510355007:0.text: I guess to a divine being, we mortals are just playthings... to be tossed aside or spared on a whim.
say:10:1510355007:0.source_cn: 所以，这次只是你偶尔兴起。对于神明而言，人类的生命是可...
say:10:1510355007:0.male: I guess to a divine being, we mortals are just playthings... to be tossed aside or spared on a whim.
say:10:1510355007:0.female: I guess to a divine being, we mortals are just playthings... to be tossed aside or spared on a whim.

say:11:1510355008:0.text: As expected from a cruel god.
say:11:1510355008:0.male: As expected from a cruel god.
say:11:1510355008:0.female: As expected from a cruel goddess.

say:13:1510355009:1.text: You are wrong. The Hunting God is not cruel.
say:13:1510355009:1.source_cn: 你错了，狩猎神大人并不残忍。
say:13:1510355009:1.male: You are wrong. The Hunting God is not cruel.
say:13:1510355009:1.female: You are wrong. The Hunting Goddess is not cruel.

say:14:1510355010:1.text: The Herdmaster allows the Wildborn to live in his lands and take from his herds, and all we need to do is give him a willing sacrifice.
say:14:1510355010:1.source_cn: 能成为兽群之主的祭品，是雅库伯尔最大的光荣！
say:14:1510355010:1.male: The Herdmaster allows the Wildborn to live in his lands and take from his herds, and all we need to do is give him a willing sacrifice.
say:14:1510355010:1.female: The Herdmaster allows the Wildborn to live in her lands and take from her herds, and all we need to do is give her a willing sacrifice.

say:15:1510355011:1.text: Therein lies his cruelty! All Wildborn sacrifices, past and present, are wrong! Horribly wrong!
say:15:1510355011:1.male: Therein lies his cruelty! All Wildborn sacrifices, past and present, are wrong! Horribly wrong!
say:15:1510355011:1.female: Therein lies her cruelty! All Wildborn sacrifices, past and present, are wrong! Horribly wrong!

say:16:1510355012:1.text: And you, clueless as you are, are the killers keeping this cycle of bloodshed going!
say:16:1510355012:1.source_cn: 而对此毫不自知的你们，正是让活祭惨剧不断上演的凶手！

say:17:1510355013:1.text: I am not a killer. I am an emissary of the divine.
say:17:1510355013:1.male: I am not a killer. I am an emissary of the divine.
say:17:1510355013:1.female: I am not a killer. I am an emissary of the divine.

say:18:1510355014:0.text: The Hunting God did not demand my sacrifice. He wished for me to live and bear witness to his deeds.
say:18:1510355014:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人不要加拉当祭品，让加拉活着，见证<male>...
say:18:1510355014:0.male: The Hunting God did not demand my sacrifice. He wished for me to live and bear witness to his deeds.
say:18:1510355014:0.female: The Hunting Goddess did not demand my sacrifice. She wished for me to live and bear witness to her deeds.

say:19:1510355015:1.text: He is not cruel at all!
say:19:1510355015:1.source_cn: 所以狩猎神大人一点也不残忍！
say:19:1510355015:1.male: He is not cruel at all!
say:19:1510355015:1.female: She is not cruel at all!

say:20:1510355016:1.text: You... Were you a sacrifice too?! You—

say:23:1510355017:1.text: Alright, let's all take a breath.

say:24:1510355018:1.text: Perseus, the Herdmaster just saved your people. What's gotten into you? Calm down. This isn't like you.
say:24:1510355018:1.source_cn: 珀尔修斯，狩猎神刚刚才拯救了你的族人，你怎么会这么冲动...
say:24:1510355018:1.male: Perseus, the Herdmaster just saved your people. What's gotten into you? Calm down. This isn't like you.
say:24:1510355018:1.female: Perseus, the Herdmaster just saved your people. What's gotten into you? Calm down. This isn't like you.

say:25:1510355019:1.text: You must realize by now that those men were suffering from <style="highlight">Sarethiel's curse</style>.
say:25:1510355019:1.source_cn: 你应该已经明白，士兵们所承受的正是<style=hig...

say:26:1510355020:0.text: His sigils appeared on the locusts, and this ravenous curse continues to spread. How long will you turn a blind eye? This all bears the touch of Sarethiel. Deny it, and you deny the truth itself.
say:26:1510355020:0.source_cn: 丰饶神的图腾纹样，食用针蝗后导致的饥饿诅咒……还需要多...

say:28:1510355022:0.text: Of course, I recognized the sigil of Sarethiel. He bestowed upon me my divine spear.
say:28:1510355022:0.source_cn: 那是丰饶神赛图恩的图腾，我当然知道……正是他将赋有神力...

say:29:1510355023:0.text: But why is he punishing the Halians?
say:29:1510355023:0.source_cn: 但是，为什么？神为什么要降罪呼临？

say:30:1510355024:1.text: If gods can truly fall and become corrupted... then what meaning do we mortals hold in the eyes of those we worship?
say:30:1510355024:1.source_cn: 如果神堕确实存在，那对信奉的神明来说，我们这些凡人信徒...

say:31:1510355025:1.text: Reason falters when gods fall. This cannot be measured by mortal logic.
say:31:1510355025:1.source_cn: 假如能用理性和逻辑判断，那就不会被称为神堕了。

say:32:1510355026:1.text: Beyond foresight and comprehension... just pure chaos and ruin. Could anyone even have predicted this?
say:32:1510355026:1.source_cn: 不可预知、无法猜测，只有混乱和蔓延的灾厄……这是你们想...

say:34:1510355028:1.text: You said the Arcane Council has a way to end the famine and save Halia.
say:34:1510355028:1.source_cn: 你说，魔法师协会有解决饥荒、拯救呼临的方法。

say:35:1510355029:1.text: Yes, it's worth trying at least.

say:36:1510355030:0.text: Then, on behalf of Halia, we welcome you.
say:36:1510355030:0.source_cn: 那么……我代表呼临城，欢迎你。

say:37:1510355031:0.text: Good. Also, the Hunting God and his little emissary are coming with me.
say:37:1510355031:0.source_cn: 还有一件事，雅库伯尔的狩猎神和<male>他</mal...
say:37:1510355031:0.male: Good. Also, the Hunting God and his little emissary are coming with me.
say:37:1510355031:0.female: Good. Also, the Hunting Goddess and her little emissary are coming with me.

choice_prompt:38:1510355031.text: Good. Also, the Hunting God and his little emissary are coming with me.
choice_prompt:38:1510355031.source_cn: 还有一件事，雅库伯尔的狩猎神和<male>他</male><female>她</female>的小神使将和我一起去。
choice_prompt:38:1510355031.male: Good. Also, the Hunting God and his little emissary are coming with me.
choice_prompt:38:1510355031.female: Good. Also, the Hunting Goddess and her little emissary are coming with me.

say:39:1510355032:0.text: <style="highlight">Only a god can fight against a god.</style>

say:40:1510355033:0.text: Let us put an end to the coming disaster together. You must understand what's at stake.
say:40:1510355033:0.source_cn: 这是为了终结呼临的灾难……展现你的睿智吧。

say:42:1510355035:0.text: Let us <style="highlight">leave at dawn</style>. Prepare yourselves.

choice:38:1:2.text: I knew I was going to get involved.
choice:38:1:2.source_cn: 就知道，这种事肯定有我
choice:38:1:2.male: I knew I was going to get involved.
choice:38:1:2.female: I knew I was going to get involved.

choice:38:2:3.source_cn: 不错，你猜到了我的想法！

choice:9:0:1.text: I can be cruel. Remember that, mortal.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 我也可以很残暴，别惹我
choice:9:0:1.male: I can be cruel. Remember that, mortal.
choice:9:0:1.female: I can be cruel. Remember that, mortal.

choice:9:1:2.text: I may change your mind yet.
choice:9:1:2.male: I may change your mind yet.
choice:9:1:2.female: I may change your mind yet.
